fields.Name: MySQL
fields.Description: Ingest data from an external MySQL, MariaDB, and Aurora-MySQL via a shared MJ: External Data Sources connection. Schema is discovered at connection time; the connector delegates connectivity to the EDS 'MySQLExternalDriver' driver.

Configuration.note: Bind this connection to a shared 'MJ: External Data Sources' row by setting Configuration.externalDataSourceID on the CompanyIntegration. Host + credentials live on that EDS row (credentials via CredentialEngine); objects/fields are discovered at connection time. Requires @memberjunction/external-data-sources + @memberjunction/external-data-source-mysql >= 5.46.0.
